headline: Caterer tasked with preparing 14 different BRICS summit menus admits he’s just serving everyone aloo parathas
body:
Q: With world leaders converging for the summit, reports indicate your team is managing 30,000 security protocols and separate dining wings. How are you handling the diplomatic pressure?

A: It’s simpler than the press makes it sound. I’ve decided that if you can’t please everyone, you please no one equally. I’ve served the exact same aloo paratha and dahi combo to every delegation since Tuesday morning.

Q: Surely the heads of state have noticed the lack of culinary diversity?

A: I told the Russian delegation it was 'Siberian-style stuffed dough' and told the others it was 'Traditional Prosperity Flatbread.' Nobody has complained yet, mostly because the security detail is too busy checking if the pickle jars are listening devices.

Q: Does the extreme security around the kitchens not hinder your ability to innovate?

A: It helps, actually. When a bomb squad sweeps your pantry for three hours before you can reach the salt, you realize that 'extra crispy' is the only garnish that matters. Diplomacy is hungry work; they’re just happy the food isn't explosive.
caption: The secret to world peace? Aloo parathas. Who knew all it took to stop a geopolitical standoff was a solid breakfast and a bit of rebranding? 🥔🌍 #BRICS2024 #Diplomacy #AlooParatha #SummitDiaries (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a world leader to handle a spicy chutney, or should we keep them on the paratha diet?
